subject: Customer outage — request for request-log slices and retention details
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novatech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novatech.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Hannah —

We experienced a sustained period of high latency and 5xx errors on our production traffic to Redwood between ~15:00 and ~16:10 PST today. Our telemetry shows a spike in tail latency and a ~8% increase in error rate which impacted a subset of our customers. Our SRE team needs two things ASAP:

1) A time-bounded slice of request/response logs and internal routing/errors for 2026-03-09 15:00:00 to 16:10:00 UTC (or nearest matching server time).
2) Confirmation of what data was written to any audit logs and how long such logs are retained; we may need proof for our compliance team.

Can you escalate and share ETA for the artifacts and whether you can provide a PII-redacted archive we can ingest into our forensics pipeline?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Principal SRE, NovaTech Solutions

[Attachment: nt_incident_screenshot_1502.png (PNG, 320KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novatech.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novatech.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 15:57:10 -0700
Subject: Re: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Elena — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. I've looped in infra and security to prioritize the request.

Short answers up front:
- We can produce time-bounded request/response slices and routing/error traces for the window you requested.
- We will provide a PII-redacted bundle and an explicit inventory of what fields were included/omitted.
- ETA: initial sanitized slice in ~6 hours; full forensics package in 24–48 hours depending on size and review.

I'm CC'ing Marissa (infra/forensics) and Jonas (platform reliability) to own extraction and retention confirmation. Raj — let us know if you want SIEM-ready formatting or any specific fields redacted beyond the standard PII policy.

Next steps: Marissa will reply with the extraction plan and a signed transfer checklist for NovaTech's security team.

-Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0134

[Attachment: incident_summary_20260309.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 15:58:05 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Team —

FYI from customer (NovaTech). They need request/response slices plus confirmation of what landed in audit logs and the retention window. Priority: high — customer-facing outage with exec-level visibility (CISO CC'ed).

Ask:
- Can we extract a sanitized request slice for 2026-03-09 15:00–16:10 UTC and provide it to them (redact PII, preserve IDs for correlation)?
- What are the retention windows for request logs, KV cache traces, and control-plane audit logs?
- Any legal/security sign-off required before we share (e.g., DLP review)?

Jonas/Marissa — can you own the extraction and outline the minimal artifacts we should give (timestamps, headers allowed, IPs hashed, etc.)? Sean, please loop in security if needed.

I placed the HubSpot ticket link in the thread and flagged for my manager if we need exec credits.

-Hannah

---- Forwarded message from Elena Torres -----
[see original below]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novatech.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@novatech.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 17:10:45 -07:00
Subject: RE: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Hannah / team / NovaTech —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick plan and constraints: we will extract the following artifacts:

1) Request/response slice (JSON lines) for 2026-03-09T15:00:00Z to 2026-03-09T16:10:00Z. Fields we will include by default: request_id, model_variant, duration_ms, status_code, retry_count, prompt_token_count, response_token_count, error_code (if any), timestamps.

2) Router/tracing events tied to those request_ids (routing decisions, fallback events, queueing delays).

3) Control-plane audit log entries referencing configuration changes or rollout events in the 6 hours around the incident.

Retention/PII notes:
- Production request logs are retained on fast storage for 30 days, and an aggregated long-term store for 365 days (per our retention policy).
- We will redact or hash IP addresses and any user-submitted PII fields. We do not include customer plaintext secrets or full raw prompts that contain PII unless explicitly requested and approved.

Security/process: we will produce a PII-redacted archive and a separate manifest describing redaction rules and checksums. A DLP review is required for any archive containing free-text prompts; Sean, can you confirm the expedited DLP path for customer forensics?

ETA: sanitized slice in ~5 hours (by 22:15 UTC), manifest + checksums by 24 hours. If NovaTech needs raw prompts for debugging, we need a written request (email from CISO) and a short data-transfer agreement addendum — I'll draft a restricted transfer SPA if needed.

Attachments: log_extraction_instructions.md (internal extraction checklist).

-M

[Attachment: log_extraction_instructions.md (text, 6KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novatech.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@novatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2026 00:14:30 +00:00
Subject: Re: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Elena / Raj —

Per Marissa's plan, attached is an initial PII-redacted request slice covering 2026-03-09T15:00:00Z to 2026-03-09T16:10:00Z. Included: request_id, timing, status, model_variant, token counts, and error fields.

What we are sending now (attached): sanitized_request_slice_20260309_1500-1600.json.gz (MD5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e) — redactions: client_ip hashed (sha256), prompt_text removed, user_id replaced with reversible redaction token so you can correlate across your telemetry if needed.

What we can provide upon written request from your security team: raw prompt text (for a smaller scoped set of request_ids) under a restricted transfer agreement. That would take additional legal/security review and an addendum to our standard data-sharing agreement.

ETA for full manifest + router traces: by end of day tomorrow (2026-03-10 23:59 UTC).

Let me know if the attached file format works for your ingestion pipeline. If yes, we'll proceed with a larger archive.

Thanks,
Hannah

[Attachment: sanitized_request_slice_20260309_1500-1600.json.gz (GZ, 2.8MB)]

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novatech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:47:55 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Hannah / Marissa —

Received the sanitized slice — thanks. Two quick clarifications from our side before we ingest:

1) Can you confirm the hashing algorithm used for client_ip and whether salts were applied? We need deterministic hashing across exports to correlate with our logs.
2) Please include a manifest that maps redaction tokens to request_ids and a checksum for every file in the archive.

If we need raw prompt text for 10 request_ids for deeper root cause analysis we will submit an email from the CISO (that's me) asking for those specific request_ids and accept the transfer agreement draft you mentioned.

If you can confirm the hash algo and push the manifest, we should be able to ingest and run forensics today.

Regards,
Raj Patel
CISO, NovaTech Solutions

>

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@novatech.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@novatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: High latency + errors Mar 9 — logs request

Raj/Elena — quick update from infra/security:

- Hashing for client_ip: sha256 with per-account salt. We will provide the salt used for NovaTech exports so hashing is deterministic for your ingestion; salt will be transmitted over the secure transfer channel and recorded in the manifest.
- Manifest: will include filename, MD5, sha256, list of included fields, count of records, and the redaction mapping file name.
- Transfer channel: S3 presigned URL with limited TTL and IP restrictions; transfer log will be recorded in our control-plane audit.

Marissa is attaching the manifest and router/tracing bundle in the shared drive link now. If that looks good you should be able to ingest and run your pipeline. If you request raw prompts for specific request_ids, email from CISO will trigger the DLP + legal path.

I'll keep this ticket open and will update HubSpot with each artifact.

-Hannah

[Attachment: transfer_manifest_nt-4821.pdf (PDF, 4KB)]
